subject: general
question: National Waterway - 3 of India is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Waterway (NW) – 3 is officially known as the **West Coast Canal**.
 
• It is located in the state of **Kerala**.
 
• This waterway stretches from **Kottapuram to Kollam**, covering a distance of approximately 205 km.
 
• The waterway also includes the **Udyogamandal and Champakara Canals**.
 
• NW-3 was declared a National Waterway in **1993**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the transportation of goods and passengers within Kerala, promoting **economic growth** and **reducing traffic congestion** on roads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The longest national waterway in India is the National Waterway 1 (NW-1).
 
• It is also known as the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system.
 
• It stretches from Prayag Raj(Allahabad) in Uttar Pradesh to Haldia in West Bengal.
 
• It has a total distance of about 1,620 kilometers.
